name: @deepseek-harness/desktop
description: Secure Electron desktop client for the enterprise AI workbench
author: Enterprise AI Workbench Team

scripts.build:main: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && npm run build:preload && node scripts/prepare-main-build.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run configure:product && electron-builder --mac --linux --x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run configure:product && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build && npm run configure:product && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run configure:product && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run configure:product && electron-builder --linux
